# A company that bought US dollars and sold every one of them
#
# 1,000.00 USD bought at 1.30 and sold at 1.40, with nothing held after.
# 
# The simplest case there is: 100.00 realized, nothing unrealized. It is
# also the case that shows what GnuCash's own Advanced Portfolio report
# makes of a book this tool writes — Money In equal to Money Out, because
# the disposal is valued at what the dollars cost, so that report sees no
# gain on the disposal and counts the 100.00 as income instead.
#
# Generated by scripts/generate-multi-currency-examples.sh. Not a
# test fixture — no test draws its figures from here — but the
# statement below is checked against what the tool prints, by
# tests/integration/test_each_worked_example_still_prints_the_statement_it_carries.py.
# Check it yourself:
#
#     gnucash-plaintext import --new /tmp/check.gnucash \
#         examples/multi-currency/every_dollar_bought_and_sold_again.txt
#     gnucash-plaintext balance-sheet /tmp/check.gnucash --as-of 2026-12-31
#
# The statement that ledger produces is at the end of this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# What `balance-sheet --as-of 2026-12-31` prints for the book above.
#
# Commented, every line of it. A statement opens with a dated
# directive — `2026-12-31 balance-sheet` — and the import reads a
# line at column 0 as one, so a file carrying both would refuse to
# import and this example would not do the one thing it is for.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# 2026-12-31 balance-sheet
# 	# An account line is that account's own balance — never its children's.
# 	# A section total, and any figure no account holds, is a key.
# 	# share_price: and value: under an account line are what this report
# 	# valued the holding at on this date, not the rate a split happened at.
# 	#
# 	# A gain already taken is stated apart from one the book has yet to
# 	# take, and only the unrealized total reaches total_equity.
# 	# gnucash_balancing_amount is GnuCash's own figure, carried across so
# 	# the two can be read against each other, and added into nothing.
# 	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 	Assets:CAD Bank 5100.00 CAD
# 	total_assets: 5100.00 CAD
# 	total_liabilities: 0.00 CAD
# 	Equity:Opening CAD 5000.00 CAD
# 	retained_earnings: 100.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_assets_fx:
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				type: asset
# 				share_price: 1.45 # current price of commodity in balance sheet currency
# 				cost_bases:
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: 57f5300faa4c482e812f5198193901e7
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 0.00
# 						cost_share_price: 1.3 # USD in CAD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 1 # CAD per CAD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 1.3 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 0.00 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 0.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 				cost_basis_balance: 0.00 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_basis_balance
# 				cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_value
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 37228586581648ec94525744f4e7dffc
# 						name: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 				balance_value: 0.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				value: 0.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 				unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 		cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each commodity's cost_value
# 		value: 0.00 # sum of each commodity's value
# 		unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 	unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx: 0.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_fx: 0.00 CAD # unrealized_gains_assets_fx + unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx
# 	realized_gains_fx:
# 		realized_gains_fx: 100.00
# 		splits:
# 			split:
# 				date: 2026-06-01
# 				account: "Income:FX Gain"
# 				amount: 100.00
# 	realized_gains_other: 0.00 CAD
# 	total_realized_gains: 100.00 CAD # realized_gains_fx + realized_gains_other
# 	unrealized_gains_other: # sum of unrealized_gains_other of all securities and funds
# 		securities: # there is no security or fund
# 		value: 0.00 # sum of each security's value
# 		cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each security's cost_value
# 		unrealized_gains_other: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 	total_unrealized_gains: 0.00 CAD # unrealized_gains_fx + unrealized_gains_other
# 	gnucash_balancing_amount: # the commodities GnuCash's own figure is summed from
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 				splits:
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: a4f78f0434f94b828412b05f72fbeea3
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: 5000.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 6821c74872194047bf5d9afea87920d7
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: -1300.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: b5616b13273b40ad88d50482dc503db5
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: 1400.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 57f5300faa4c482e812f5198193901e7
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						value: 1300.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: b6005e2af4cf47caaf376ea8cbb790a5
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						value: -1300.00
# 				sum_value: 5100.00 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 3afb46a975da40fc8d90f0f3bb71d0b9
# 						name: "Assets"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: 10c28d7e05a046b39d62f2441ddbe7b2
# 						name: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						balance: 5100.00
# 				balance_value: 5100.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: 0.00 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: 0.00 # 0.00 CAD at 1 CAD per CAD
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				splits: # there is no split
# 				sum_value: 0.00 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 37228586581648ec94525744f4e7dffc
# 						name: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 				balance_value: 0.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: 0.00 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: 0.00 # 0.00 USD at 1.45 CAD per USD
# 		gnucash_balancing_amount: 0.00 # sum of balance_sheet_value of all commodities
# 	total_equity: 5100.00 CAD
# 	total_liabilities_and_equity: 5100.00 CAD
